    Since the difference in pressure is the same for both, the toy rocket with the larger volume of water would have a lower initial acceleration due to its higher mass.

    Fn(b)​−mg=Rmvb​2​

    Fn(b)​=mg+Rmvb​2​

    Fn(b)​=mg+R2mgh​

    At the top of the loop.

    mgh=21​mvt​2+2mgR

    gh=21​vt​2+2gR

    vt​2=2gh−4gR

    Fn(t)​+mg=Rmvt​2​

    Fn(t)​=Rmvt​2​−mg

    Fn(t)​=Rm(2gh−4gR)​−mg

    Fn(t)​=R2mgh−4mgR​−mg

    Fn(t)​=R2mgh​−4mg−mg

    Fn(t)​=R2mgh​−5mg

    Fn(b)​−Fn(t)​=(mg+R2mgh​)−(R2mgh​−5mg)

    Fn(b)​−Fn(t)​=6mg

    The difference in normal force only depends on mass m and gravity g.
